output.summary: Since August, changes to billing import validation rules have introduced systematic calculation errors that produce incorrect bills, leading to a doubling of dispute tickets. [PD-1] [E-04] [E-01] [E-11] Dispute ticket volume rose from ~600 per month in June‑July to >1100 in August and >1200 in September (E-04). Disputed bills with actual reads exceed those with estimated reads (E-01), showing the increase is not due to estimation alone. Billing import rejected high‑consumption AMI reads (E-11) indicates rule changes are blocking valid reads and causing estimation substitution. The release includes monitoring dispute volume (DA‑TICKET) and alerting on bill anomalies (DA‑BILL) as defined in the release scope. The gate resulted in CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs; the two open VOBs (U‑U1 and U‑U2) pertain to reviewing billing rule changes and validating bill calculation, which are outside the current release scope, allowing release with known limitations. Limitations: DEFINE Gate CONDITIONAL_PASS (deferred items tracked as VOBs); VOB‑U‑U1 open; blocking_scope outside release scope; VOB‑U‑U2 open; blocking_scope outside release scope.
